notes.title: Trapped: Family Vacation is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello horror lovers!

I am so excited to announce that my solo developed indie horror game, Trapped: Family Vacation, is now available!

[previewyoutube=KIBt7tzFC4w;full][/previewyoutube]

You are trapped in a hotel. A mysterious person offers you a way out—but only if you complete their twisted game. 

Your mission?
📍🔎Review old camera footage of the rooms
📍📹Spot five differences
📍🗒️But beware, each room has a survival rule!  

Will you escape this nightmare vacation, or will you be trapped forever?

I’d love to hear your thoughts! Leave a review and share your experience with the community.

Happy escaping... if you can. 😱

Burak
New Forge Games

notes.title: Ready for Steam Next Fest with a Polished Demo!
notes.content:
Trapped: Family Vacation is ready for the upcoming Steam Next Fest with a polished demo!

After reviewing several playthroughs of the demo, I've made significant improvements to ensure a smooth and engaging gameplay experience for all players. Below is a detailed list of the latest updates:

[list]
[*] New starting room added to enhance the player's introduction to the game
[*] Updated first message on the in-game computer to improve clarity and set a better tone
[*] Improved player feedback upon successfully completing a room, providing clearer progression
[*] Fixed the language selection bug
[*] Adjusted difficulty for a more balanced challenge
[*] Fine-tuned walking and running speed to improve movement flow
[*] Player height adjusted to match the perspective of a child
[*] Brightened the camera view in Room 103 for better visibility
[*] Fixed the clown head rotation bug for smoother animations
[*] Objects now highlight after being marked, improving visual feedback for players
[*] Added a typewriter effect to computer messages for added immersion
[*] Added a new sound effect after the player gets caught
[*] Added a Shift key - Run tutorial to assist players with movement controls
[/list]

Additionally, I’m planning to expand the demo with new language support in the coming weeks. The following languages are expected to be included: French, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued feedback!
